classification: Frozen semantic definitions, NOT executable candidate passes or promised new APIs

controls.inputs: Existing discovery/direct/command routes; same-name function; command registry inventory
controls.assert: getopts is a regular shell builtin, not a special builtin or command plugin. Existing type, type -t, command -v/-V and command execution find/bypass functions appropriately. No default command aggregate registration or export expansion.
controls.unsupported: builtin dispatcher and declare/typeset commands are absent at baseline. Do not require their syntax or implement them in this sidecar. If later supported, freeze a separate builtin-getopts route supplement before execution.

controls.inputs: Fresh shell without OPTIND/OPTERR; then inherited exported OPTIND=7 OPTERR=0; separate new virtual interpreter
controls.assert: New defaults OPTIND=1 and OPTERR=1 are unexported when created afresh. Inherited exported attributes remain exported while startup text resets to1 under the declared profile. OPTARG is not fabricated. Separate fresh interpreters do not reuse another shell's cursor.
controls.pending: Final host fixture binding must use inspected public APIs, not invented constructors or extra controls.

controls.assert: Successful plain, arithmetic, parameter-assignment, read, for and value-declaration writes synchronize OPTIND; explicit same-value1 resets. Builtin-produced OPTIND=1 and result-name=OPTIND do not reset. Prefix install/restore synchronize independently, not by local-frame snapshot. Bare declarations do not reset. Unsupported declare/typeset syntax is not demanded.
controls.pending: D01 covers failed readonly setters. D03 covers middleware overlays; unchanged environment forwarding must not accidentally reset.

controls.inputs: N05-N09/N15; independently cloned pending invocations and two fresh shells
controls.assert: Bash5.3 function-entry hidden snapshot is restored iff OPTIND was actually localized; repeated local declarations cannot replace the entry snapshot. Rejected local must not create a successful restore frame. Dynamic OPTARG/OPTERR alone do not save/reset cursor. Subshell/pipeline/substitution clones own hidden state; group/source/eval share it. Child abort does not mutate the parent or sibling cursor.
controls.pending: Host clone fixture shape waits for integration; no public clone API is proposed.

controls.inputs: N11-N15; readonly OPTIND, OPTARG and destination separately and together; destination OPTIND/OPTARG/__proto__/bad-name/bad[0]
controls.assert: Readonly value and attribute cannot be removed or bypassed by getopts, including unset OPTARG intent and EOF. Later ordinary unset/assignment still refuse. Invalid scalar identifiers do not create keys or prototype effects. Existing scalar capability only; no arrays or namerefs.
controls.intentionalDivergence: Native readonly OPTARG deletion is NEVER acceptance. Preserve captured native quirk separately.
controls.pending: D01 specifies unresolved partial-write ordering, exact status and diagnostics; do not silently impose native statuses or transactional rollback.

controls.inputs: ASCII optstring/option with required value 雪🙂; non-ASCII optstring and selected non-ASCII option; ordinary Unicode positionals
controls.assert: ASCII option policy refuses non-ASCII options explicitly, without native byte-emulation; Unicode values/positionals remain intact within bounds. No host IO is a workaround.
controls.intentionalDivergence: Non-ASCII native option bytes are not product equalities.
controls.pending: D02 selects adapter-level error/status/diagnostic mapping; no extra public error enum is invented.

controls.inputs: A small valid script whose individually bounded calls exceed an already-partly-used shared shell budget; same across nested command/function/pipeline/invoke, plus admitted input/diagnostic output limits
controls.assert: Charge the existing shared execution/output/depth infrastructure; no fresh budget per getopts, standalone family-limit substitution, unbounded admission or duplicate terminal buffering. Preserve byte ownership/backpressure and existing limit identity. One passing scanner cap does not certify runtime accounting.
controls.pending: D02: exact mapping of scanner work units to existing shell limits and checkpoint cadence needs owner/root choice before typed fixtures; do not add a guessed ShellLimits field.

controls.inputs: Pre-abort and abort during cooperative pending work/diagnostic write; reasons object sentinel,false,0,empty string,null; late rejecting and late resolving work
controls.assert: Forward the actual supplied signal to cooperative work. Preserve cancellation reason identity per existing contract; observe late rejection, prevent resumed publication after cancellation, settle once, and preserve parent/sibling state. Await registered cooperative cleanup/admitted owned work. Do not promise to stop opaque host work or undo completed effects.
controls.pending: D01/D02: cursor/variable effects already completed before cancellation must be specified by stage; no blanket rollback/status promise.

controls.inputs: Unknown/missing-option diagnostic into a gated ByteSink; then rejecting write, closed sink, bounded output and retained/reused producer chunks; OPTERR=0 and colon silence controls
controls.assert: Await writes and backpressure; exact diagnostic bytes remain on stderr, never fallback stdout/host console. Silent controls perform zero diagnostic writes. A sink failure is not a successful getopts result; surface through existing runtime failure path, observe late rejection and finish cooperative cleanup. No fabricated errno serialization.
controls.pending: D01/D02: exact publication order/status after a sink failure awaits final adapter API. Typed fixtures use actual ByteSink/invoke shapes only after release.

controls.inputs: Actual public invocation of literal getopts argv through existing middleware, merge environment and replaceEnv=true with omitted/explicit env; unexported/local parent values; transparent stdin and explicit replacement
controls.assert: Do not parse metacharacters in literal argv, bypass middleware, create an independent shell budget, leak parent exports/locals, inject PWD into replaceEnv=true, or confuse stdin provenance with EOF. Preserve parent state and existing command contract; no assumed new hook or TypeScript signature.
controls.pending: D03: define getopts hidden-state ownership and changed OPTIND overlay install/restore within actual invoke lifecycle; do not equate environment replacement with a fresh shell or infer an assignment from unchanged forwarding.

controls.inputs: Pre-admitted direct builtin with instrumented VFS, stdin, process/network access and stdout; explicit argv vs positionals; N03/N08 fixtures tracked separately as harness/shell effects
controls.assert: getopts itself does not read stdin/VFS, spawn processes, access network/ambient credentials, or write stdout. Only admitted argument/state operations and authorized diagnostic sink writes occur. Shell redirection/source fixture reads and discovery harness work are not charged as invented getopts IO. Sentinel stdin remains unread, including cancellation/error cases.

controls.inputs: Usage error, invalid destination, readonly I/A/name combinations, parser diagnostic failure and cancellation at each admitted stage
controls.assert: Record pre/post visible bindings, exported/readonly attributes, hidden continuation via a later valid scan, exact output and actual status/error independently. Distinguish early usage rejection from late binding failures. Never collapse all failures into one status, relax diagnostic assertions globally or promise an all-or-nothing transaction.
controls.pending: D01 is a required root decision, not a passing case. Frozen native N11-N15 are observations that inform this decision, not authority overriding stronger readonly.

decisions.question: Specify readonly/invalid-name partial-write order and status (including OPTIND, OPTARG set/unset, destination, parser diagnostic and hidden cursor) and failed setter/reset behavior under stronger readonly. Hard invariant: never delete or strip readonly OPTARG. No rollback inferred.
Choose existing shared-budget/work-checkpoint mapping and adapter error/sink/cancellation publication semantics before concrete typed host fixtures. No new public controls assumed.

Bind actual invoke/middleware state ownership and explicit changed-OPTIND overlay restoration; unchanged forwarding cannot reset. Any future builtin dispatcher support needs a separately frozen route supplement.
